title: Klarna and Rare Carat team up to bring flexible payments to engagement ring shopping | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**New York, September 2, 2026** – Klarna, the everyday finance network, today announced a new partnership with


[Rare Carat](https://www.rarecarat.com/)


, one of the largest online diamond and engagement ring retailers in the U.S., to give shoppers more flexible ways to pay for one of life's most memorable purchases.


The average engagement ring in the U.S. now costs between $5,000 and $6,500, and more than a third of couples cover that cost with revolving credit with no fixed payoff date. Rare Carat customers can now choose Klarna's full suite of payment options at checkout instead, including pay in full, interest-free Pay in 4, and new


[0% APR financing](https://www.rarecarat.com/learn/financing-options)


across 3, 6, or 12-month terms.


"An engagement ring is one of the most meaningful purchases someone will ever make, and paying for it is just as personal as the ring they choose,” said Lisa Robinson, Head of Partner Success, US East Coast and Canada at Klarna. "By bringing pay in full, interest-free pay in four and 0% APR financing to Rare Carat, we're giving consumers the flexibility this purchase deserves.”


"Rare Carat was built to bring transparency to diamond shopping, and payment flexibility is a natural extension of that," said Julien Saad, CEO of Rare Carat. "With Klarna, our customers can find the perfect ring for that big moment using a payment method that works best for them.”


**About Klarna**
Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Apple, Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit Klarna.com.
